sources.title: EschaLabs/escha-runtime-qwen3dense · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The serving runtime for Escha 2-/3-bit (escha) quantized models of the qwen3_5 dense architecture (Qwen3.8-27B and siblings). One repo per model architecture, one directory per engine — this architecture currently has one engine, sglang/.

sources.title: r3lax/escha-runtime-qwen3dense · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: Escha Labs — The LLM Compression Company
sources.snippet: Escha Labs — extreme low-bit model compression. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Escha-W2 is a 35B-parameter model in 12.3 GB that holds 100.2% of its FP8 baseline's mean across six capability benchmarks and decodes 225 tok/s on one RTX 4090.

sources.title: Escha 2-Bit Qwen3.8-27B: A 27B Model in 10GB
sources.snippet: The Hugging Face model page went up roughly three hours before this piece, published by an account called yzhwang, alongside a companion repo named escha-runtime-qwen3dense.

sources.title: Escha Labs on X: "Escha 2-bit Qwen3.8-27B is live! The full model is 10 ...
sources.snippet: Escha 2-bit Qwen3.8-27B is live! The full model is 10.15GB on disk, runs at 82.6 tok/s on a single RTX 5090 with our custom SGLang runtime, and averages ~100% of FP8 performance across 8 benchmarks we've run so far.
